Messages.Author: echia...@yahoo.com
Messages.Body:
Taking the Skin: Minion
Action Modifier/Combat
Abombwe
abo: Reflex. Cancel a frenzy card played on this vampire as it is
played.
abo: Skin. Play when this vampire burns a minion. Put this card on
this vampire and untap him or her. This vampire may bleed an
additional time this turn and gets +1 bleed and +1 stealth when
bleeding. Burn this card during your discard phase. A minion can have
only one skin.

Uchenna Bum's Rushes a Nocturn, burning it and playing Taking the
Skin: Minion. Uchenna then bleeds and Freak Drives. He bleeds for a
second time (due to Taking the Skin: Minion) and Freak Drives again.

If Taking the Skin: Minion is burned (say, via Cleansing Ritual or
someone else using a Smear Campaign) and then Uchenna plays a new
Taking the Skin: Minion (after burning another Nocturn), may he then
bleed a third time? (Or does the second Taking the Skin factor in that
he has already bled twice and not allow a third time?)

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


A vampire gets Taking the Skin: Minion and then bleeds twice. If that Skin is
burned somehow and the vampire gets another Taking the Skin: Minion, does the
new Skin's "may bleed an additional time this turn" text mean he can bleed again
this turn?

Yes.
